content: Clarithromycin is available in various formulations and packaging options, as described below: 1. Biaxin® Filmtab® (Clarithromycin Tablets, USP): These are film-sealed tablets manufactured by AbbVie Inc. Available in 250 mg and 500 mg strengths. The product is labeled as prescription-only (Rx only). Packaging details include: 250 mg tablets, 60-count bottle (NDC 0074-2586-60). 500 mg tablets, 60-count bottle (NDC 0074-3165-60). 500 mg tablets, 100-count bottle, specifically labeled for households without young children (NDC 0074-3165-41). 2. Biaxin® XL Filmtab® (Clarithromycin Extended-Release Tablets): These are extended-release tablets, also manufactured by AbbVie Inc. Available in a 500 mg strength. Packaging details include: 500 mg tablets, 60-count bottle (NDC 0074-2586-11). Unit-of-use packaging containing 14 tablets for a 7-day course of treatment. 3. Biaxin® Granules for Oral Suspension: This formulation is intended for oral suspension and is available in two concentrations: 125 mg/5 mL. 250 mg/5 mL. The product is manufactured by AbbVie Ltd., Barceloneta, Puerto Rico, 00617. 4. Biaxin® XL Pack: This pack contains a 7-day course of antibiotic treatment. The usual dosage is two 500 mg extended-release tablets taken once daily with food. Patients are advised not to accept the product if the blister seal is broken. All formulations are clearly labeled with their respective National Drug Code (NDC) numbers and are intended for prescription use only.
